method: Each Part opens with a whole cover page reading '<TITLE> PART n' (PDF contents page p2 lists Parts 1-12). A Part owns its cover page and every page up to the next Part's cover. Pages 1-3 (title, contents) belong to no Part and stay unresolved. Read 2026-10-20 from the PDF; agrees with every printed page label 'n - x' (8,674 served rows) and a 30-row read of the PDF. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages (= regulatory_provisions.pdf_page).
